**3 / 944 explicitly exported C functions covered (0.32%)**

The denominator is the set of `IGRAPH_EXPORT` declarations with literal `igraph_*` names in upstream headers. A function is covered when production Go code calls that name via cgo. Template-generated APIs (notably typed vectors) are intentionally outside the denominator. This is a mechanical inventory, not a claim of behavioral or test coverage.
